title: Page 97
transc:
12.30 P. M.
A. H. Caldwoll Hd Qrs. A. of P.  Washington June 21. 1864.
Topsy Luke Oliver Brown For Spark In gulls
Arnold Davis sets of rail twisters will go
forward by mail boat this evening Austin Douglas
more tomorrow or next day yardstick I have
requested ordnance Dept to send pewter tor pea
does The only mode of blowing up a
Canal culvert or any masonry culvert is to
barricade and tamp the culvert putting sufficient powder
in the center yacht As the quantity of
powder needed is large and the time employed
considerable and as any walnut culvert can be
piloted by a piece of timber I do
not think it will be worth while to
undertake to blow up such culverts yardstick Canal
culverts however should if possible be blown up
period Powder in barrels should be used with
cannon fuse signed Buggy longest day of year
